affinity.notes: Natural swamp coloration carries no strong magical or elemental coding.

identity.notes: Blind perception "spined swamp reptile" semantically identifies lizardfolk/lizardfolk-spineback.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "normal" is accepted for intended T3 under the documented v2 normalization.
